description: This file defines a utility class 'SessionUtil' with static methods to get, set, and remove session attributes from an HttpServletRequest object. It simplifies session attribute management within a Java web application.

classes.name: SessionUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manipulate session attributes in an HTTP request context.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by key from the HttpServletRequest, with generic type casting.

methods.name: removeSessionAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute specified by key from the HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the given key and value in the HttpServletRequest.
